headline: Prioritize usability: shuffle/track control and ad interruptions carry the most complaint weight, though verification is absent.
recommendation: Usability has the largest topic complaint count, 20 [T1], and a share of 39.2% of all complaints [T4], with the highest priority scores among top issues. Within it, shuffle or track control scores 21 [C8] and ads score 19 [C12]. Start with these two issues, and treat the results as directional because no verifier sample was run [X9] and 17 records still need review [X8].

actions.title: Fix shuffle and track-control behavior in playlists and single-track playback
actions.rationale: This issue has 7 complaints [C5] and a severity sum of 21 [C6], the highest severity total among the top issues. Reviews describe random playlist order and an inability to go back a few seconds.

actions.title: Reduce ad frequency and ad placement between tracks for free-tier users
actions.rationale: Ads show 8 complaints [C9] with a severity sum of 19 [C10]. Reviews describe ads appearing every one or two songs, which makes the product feel unusable.

actions.title: Validate the usability findings with a manual sample before committing the quarter
actions.rationale: Zero records have been verified [X9], and 17 records are flagged for review [X8]. A targeted check of the top usability items would confirm the ranking before major investment.

alternatives.why_not_first: Billing has 5 complaints [T13] with a severity sum of 14 [T14], and the premium paywall issue has 4 complaints [C13]. Its volume is well below usability, and the paywall complaints overlap with the premium-gated controls already covered under usability.

Playback has 7 complaints [T9], close to usability in count but with a severity sum of 22 [T10]. Its top issue, crash or won't open, has only 2 complaints [C21], so the signal is concentrated in fewer reports.
Access has only 2 complaints [T21] and a share of 3.9% [T24]. The login failure issue is small in volume, though its mean severity is 4.000000 [C19], so it is worth monitoring.

limitations: The data is self-selected public reviews from May 2022 to November 2023 [X1] and does not represent all users.
The dataset contains no revenue, plan tier, or confirmed churn; cancellation language reflects expressed intent only, with 8 cancellation-intent records [X6].
No verifier sample was run and no agreement or error metrics are available [X9][X10][X11][X12].
17 records still need review [X8], so classifications may shift.
Quotes are short excerpts and may not capture full context.
